ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral plane, exhibiting high global contrast.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity (black) region forming a wide 'V' shape from the peduncle to the notch. Distal regions of both lobes are high-intensity (white). High-frequency black mottling and speckling are present along the leading edges and the transition boundaries between black and white fields. A distinct cluster of four small black circular spots is visible on the right white lobe near the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1:1.2 relative to the immediate lobe transition.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely irregular trailing edge with high-amplitude serrations. A significant, deep U-shaped notch or indentation is present on the upper-left lobe trailing edge. Right lobe edge features smaller, more frequent periodic peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the peduncle toward the notch, transitioning to a broadly convex curve toward the distal tips of the lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast, textured yellowish-brown clusters localized on the extreme distal tips and along the upper leading edges of both lobes, consistent with sessile organism colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, thin greyish-white linear marks (rake marks) are visible: three parallel diagonal lines in the left central black region and one prominent horizontal line on the right white lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular excision/notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe and significant biological encrustation on both distal lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The boundary between the central black pigment and the white lobes is not sharp but consists of a 'feathered' pixel distribution with numerous micro-islands of black pigment.
